home.hero_title: The elegance of the caftan, for your finest moments
home.hero_lede: Caftan Zomoroda opens its wardrobe of exceptional caftans, takchitas and jellabas. Choose your piece, book your dates, and shine — without compromise.
home.steps_description: Three simple steps, from your first visit to the big day.
home.step1_body: Browse the collection and find the piece made for your occasion — wedding, engagement, evening or celebration.
home.step2_body: Create your account, enter your rental dates and send your request. We confirm availability quickly.
home.step3_body: Pick up your caftan prepared with care, wear it, then simply return it. We take care of the rest.
home.values_description: A house dedicated to the art of the Moroccan caftan and to the care of every client.
home.value1_body: Caftans selected for their craftsmanship: embroidery, noble fabrics and traditional finishing.
home.value2_body: Every piece is inspected, cleaned and prepared by professionals between rentals.
home.value3_body: A question about size, dates or style? Our team answers you directly on WhatsApp.
home.cta_body: Create your account in one minute to book your caftans and track your requests online.
